import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http'; @Component({ selector: 'app-add-product', templateUrl: './add-product.component.html', styleUrls: ['./add-product.component.css'], }) export class AddProductComponent { name: string = ''; description: string = ''; price: number = 0; image: File | null = null; constructor(private http: HttpClient) {} onFileChange(event: any) { this.image = event.target.files[0]; } onSubmit() { if (!this.image) { alert('Please select an image.'); return; } const formData = new FormData(); formData.append('name', this.name); formData.append('description', this.description); formData.append('price', this.price.toString()); formData.append('image', this.image); this.http.post('http://localhost:8080/api/items', formData).subscribe({ next: (res) => { alert('Product added successfully!'); this.resetForm(); }, error: (err) => { console.error(err); alert('Error adding product.'); }, }); } resetForm() { this.name = ''; this.description = ''; this.price = 0; this.image = null; } }
